ValidationRule.description: HU1 PM - RN04 Opportunity: no permitir reabrir una Opportunity PM cuando ya estaba Closed Won o Closed Lost.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Oportunidad_Personas_Morales", NOT(ISNEW()), ISCHANGED(StageName), OR( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Closed Won"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Closed Lost") ), NOT( OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Lost") ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: No puedes reabrir una oportunidad cerrada.
